title: NFL Rules Authority Pack
source_name: Executed 2020 NFL-NFLPA CBA and NFL Football Operations
notes: Public-demo authority pack. It is not legal advice and does not replace league transaction systems or club counsel.
Every rule includes an exact public locator and an analysis boundary; player-specific calculations still require a captured contract ledger.
The executed-CBA SHA-256 recorded on CBA rows was verified at retrieval.

rules.title: Salary-to-signing-bonus restructure
rules.summary: Amounts treated as signing bonus are allocated under the CBA signing-bonus rules; exact relief depends on eligible compensation and remaining contract years.
rules.analysis_use: Permit an exact restructure lever only when the captured player ledger contains eligible salary and remaining years.
rules.source_locator: Article 13, Section 6(b)(i) and 6(b)(iii), CBA pages 109-111 (PDF pages 126-128)
rules.bounded_excerpt: Signing bonus is generally prorated straight-line over the contract term, subject to a five-year maximum and acceleration rules.
rules.analysis_boundary: The rule neither proves a unilateral restructure right nor establishes a contract-specific available amount.
rules.source_note: Executed agreement; pair with the captured player contract and cap ledger.

rules.title: Post-June 1 release or trade accounting
rules.summary: The CBA distinguishes bonus acceleration for releases or assignments on or before June 1 from transactions after June 1 and limits early-release designations.
rules.analysis_use: Compare pre- and post-June timing only from captured bonus schedules and never apply both actions to one player in one branch.
rules.bounded_excerpt: Unamortized signing bonus generally accelerates in the current year on or before June 1; specified later treatment moves future-year acceleration to the next league year.
rules.analysis_boundary: Designation availability, bonus schedules, guarantees, and the live transaction date must be confirmed before execution.
rules.source_note: Executed agreement; the model cannot execute or promise a designation.

rules.title: Franchise and transition tenders
rules.summary: The CBA defines annual franchise and transition designations, tender calculations, designation periods, and negotiation rights.
rules.analysis_use: Use as a decision trigger for a qualifying expiring player; current tender amounts and the live league calendar remain required inputs.
rules.source_locator: Article 10, Sections 1-4 and 9-10, CBA pages 58-63 (PDF pages 75-80)
rules.bounded_excerpt: A club may make the permitted annual designation during the defined window, with tender treatment governed by Article 10.
rules.analysis_boundary: Do not infer current-year tender values or eligibility from this summary.
rules.source_note: Executed agreement; current league-year dates and tender values require separate verification.

rules.title: Rookie deals, renegotiation, and fifth-year options
rules.summary: Article 7 governs rookie contracts, including signing-bonus proration, renegotiation restrictions, and first-round fifth-year options.
rules.analysis_use: Use for timing gates on extension or option decisions after confirming draft round and contract year.
rules.source_locator: Article 7, Sections 3(g), 3(k), and 7, CBA pages 31-33 and 41-44 (PDF pages 48-50 and 58-61)
rules.bounded_excerpt: Drafted-rookie contracts generally cannot be renegotiated until after the player's third regular season; Article 7 separately governs first-round fifth-year options.
rules.analysis_boundary: Draft round, accrued contract year, option tier, and current deadline must be sourced before recommending action.
rules.source_note: Executed agreement; use player-specific draft and contract evidence.

rules.title: Practice squad and roster churn
rules.summary: NFL Football Operations describes current practice-squad size, eligibility categories, elevations, and protections.
rules.analysis_use: Use as a roster-construction alternative for eligible depth players.
rules.source_document: NFL Football Operations: NFL Practice Squad Rules
rules.source_locator: Page headings 'How many players are on an NFL practice squad?' and 'How are practice squad contracts handled?'
rules.bounded_excerpt: The official explainer describes a 16-player practice squad and bounded elevation and protection mechanics.
rules.analysis_boundary: Confirm the current season memo, player eligibility, elevation history, and active-roster limits.

rules.title: IR, PUP, and NFI availability lists
rules.summary: Roster availability designations affect active-roster occupancy and return timing, while medical and contract conclusions remain player-specific.
rules.analysis_use: Use only to flag availability dependencies and required club confirmation.
rules.source_document: NFL Football Operations: 2026 Important NFL Dates
rules.source_locator: 2026 page entries under August roster reduction and reserve-list deadlines
rules.bounded_excerpt: Official calendar entries identify roster-reduction and reserve-list transaction deadlines for the league year.
rules.analysis_boundary: No medical status, return date, or guaranteed-salary conclusion is inferred from a public list label.
rules.source_note: Official NFL Football Operations calendar; club medical and transaction systems control.

rules.title: Waiver claims and vested veterans
rules.summary: Waiver mechanics depend on service status and the league calendar, changing whether a released contract may be claimed.
rules.analysis_use: Use to surface a transaction dependency for release and reacquisition scenarios.
rules.bounded_excerpt: The official explainer distinguishes termination from waivers and notes the role of credited seasons.
rules.analysis_boundary: Verify credited seasons, transaction timing, and live waiver priority.

rules.title: Compensatory pick resolution boundary
rules.summary: NFL Resolution JC-2A describes additional compensatory selections for qualifying minority-employee hires into head coach or primary football executive roles.
rules.analysis_use: Use only for the resolution's bounded hiring scenario, not the separate free-agent compensatory formula.
rules.source_locator: Page heading '2020 Resolution JC-2A' and resolution paragraphs 1-3
rules.bounded_excerpt: The resolution awards specified draft choices when a qualifying minority employee is hired into an eligible role by another club.
rules.analysis_boundary: This source does not document the free-agent compensatory formula; unsupported free-agent-comp claims must abstain.
rules.source_note: Official NFL resolution with intentionally narrow analysis use.

rules.title: Player assignment and trade cap treatment
rules.summary: The league calendar defines trading windows while CBA signing-bonus acceleration controls the assigning club's cap treatment.
rules.analysis_use: Use captured trade-dead and trade-relief ledger fields only.
rules.bounded_excerpt: On assignment, the original club's unamortized signing-bonus treatment follows the timing rules, and the new team's salary excludes the original signing bonus.
rules.analysis_boundary: Trade approval, acquiring-team obligations, guarantees, and the current deadline must be independently confirmed.
rules.source_note: Executed agreement; pair with the current league calendar and player contract.

rules.title: Team salary cap accounting
rules.summary: Article 13 defines Team Salary and core accounting treatments for salary, bonuses, incentives, acceleration, and offseason roster counting.
rules.analysis_use: Use as the umbrella authority boundary; player figures come from captured contract rows.
rules.bounded_excerpt: Team Salary includes defined player compensation and accounting adjustments, with detailed treatment in Article 13.
rules.analysis_boundary: This pack is not a club cap certification; exact room and league adjustments require current league records.
rules.source_note: Executed agreement; deterministic outputs remain scoped to loaded public contract rows.

rules.title: Contract extensions and renegotiations
rules.summary: The CBA governs extension-bonus proration and timing restrictions for contract renegotiations and extensions.
rules.analysis_use: Treat extension relief as directional unless complete proposed deal terms are visibly user-entered.
rules.source_locator: Article 13, Sections 6(b)(i)(4) and 8, CBA pages 109-110 and 125-126 (PDF pages 126-127 and 142-143)
rules.bounded_excerpt: An extension bonus is generally prorated over the unexpired contract together with the extension, while renegotiations remain subject to timing restrictions.
rules.analysis_boundary: Without sourced proposed terms, the engine may show an extension as a next action but cannot claim exact relief.
rules.source_note: Executed agreement; player-specific proposed terms are mandatory for exact figures.
